top_signals.title: China Is Rapidly Catching Up to the US in the AI Race
top_signals.summary:
China is rapidly catching up to the US in the AI race, especially on price.

But how do Chinese models compare in quality? We put seven models to the test by asking each to build a website for a coffee shop. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
